correctness.rationale: For u>=1, T0=1,T1=u,T_{n+2}=2uT_{n+1}+T_n and each prime p, normalized local p-parts A_n=p^vp(T_n) are studied by Möbius Dold divisibility. At odd p|u²+1 the local sequence is 1. Otherwise ratio x=-alpha² in Fp² has order m|p±1; if m odd there is no p divisibility, else m=2r and p|T_n exactly at n=r*h with h odd. Odd-index LTE yields vp(T_{rh})=c+vp(h), with Möbius transforms supported at r,2r,rp^j,2rp^j and negative at 2r. Their denominators yield optimal repair factor 2r/gcd(2r,p-1). Frobenius and quadratic reciprocity give bad Dold p exactly inert p≡3 mod4; independent quadratic characters (-1/p) and ((u²+1)/p) imply natural density 1/4 for bad primes and 3/4 good. At p=2, odd u gives constant one, even u has A_odd=2^vp(u), A_even=1 and F=2, negative at n=2. Finite verifier is not a density proof.
